en: A colorized historic postcard showing a square with people in early 20th‑century clothing walking in front of ornate buildings and a city gate. On the left is a large red‑brick hotel with decorative stonework; in the center‑right is a tall brick gate tower; to the far right is a monumental arched gate with sculptural reliefs. German text is printed at the bottom naming the scene, and a vertical caption along the left margin identifies the postcard publisher.
